19372.ins: One-piece construction pays its way at the end of the evening: no separate top to find, no skirt to step out of, nothing lost between rooms. Lace mesh wants a wash bag on gentle and a flat dry to keep the pattern square.
19372.short: Sweet lace mesh bride jumpsuit in one piece with bridal styling, as pictured, one size for 40-60 kg, single-garment costume.

19380.ins: Patent leather stage wear wipes down after a performance - sweat and stage dust come off with a damp cloth, and the patchwork seams are the places to be gentle with. Store hanging to keep the panels from creasing along the seams.
19380.short: Red patchwork patent leather stage set with Christmas styling, M and L sizes covering 40-65 kg, shine under stage light.

19382.ins: The two-piece format travels better than the full uniform sets - top and skirt fold flat into a bag without the collar and headgear taking revenge. Chiffon shakes out its travel creases in an hour hung in a steamy bathroom.
19382.short: Preppy chiffon sailor dress set with top and short skirt, one size for 40-60 kg, two-piece costume for parties and photoshoots.

19394.ins: Two-piece minimalism has a practical side: the top works under other costumes as a layer, and the thong pairs with anything. Chiffon in as-pictured colorway washes gentle and dries fast, which suits a piece meant for single evenings.
19394.short: Chiffon nightclub set with top and matching thong in as-pictured colorway, one size for 40-60 kg, two-piece costume lingerie.

19403.ins: Six pieces arrive matched in the same pink plush - the usual failure of self-assembled bunny outfits is the near-miss shades between bought-separately pieces, and this set closes that gap at the source. Plush wants a lint roller, not a wash, between wears.
19403.short: Pink plush bunny girl set with headband, sleeves, top, neck ring, skirt and belt, six pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

19424.ins: Coral fleece is machine-washable on cold and comes out of the dryer soft rather than matted - the reason it beats costume fur for anything worn more than once. The neck ring and bracelet are the pieces that mark it as costume rather than loungewear.
19424.short: Coral fleece bear-style bandeau dress with neck ring and bracelet in white or brown, one size for 40-60 kg, cozy three-piece set.

19461.ins: The red-and-white contrast is the whole visual engine of the set, so a cold gentle wash keeps the red from wandering into the apron. Polyester dries overnight on a hanger, which suits a costume with a December calendar.
19461.short: Red polyester Christmas maid set with dress, apron and headband, three pieces, one size for 40-60 kg, holiday costume.

19467.ins: A slip dress is the least-fuss costume format there is: one motion to dress, one motion to undress, and nothing between. The headband and neck ring carry the Christmas cues so the slip itself stays a plain, repeatable red piece.
19467.short: Red Christmas slip dress with plush bow trim, headband and neck ring in chiffon, three pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

19547.ins: Red chiffon under candlelight is the register this dress was built for - the fabric is thin enough to move with air and the neck ring keeps the bunny reference from getting lost in the longer line. Hand wash, hang dry, wear again.
19547.short: Red chiffon bunny girl evening dress with neck ring, one size for 40-60 kg, dressed-up costume option for dinner-party wear.

19561.ins: The lace-up front doubles as the fit system: cinch it for a shaped waist, loosen it for a relaxed night in. Coral fleece washes cold and comes back soft, and brown reads bear without any accessories - though the matching bandeau set is one room over.
19561.short: Brown coral fleece bear-style skirt with adjustable lace-up front, one size for 40-60 kg, mix-and-match cozy costume piece.
